Requirement Statement: The workflow shall run only in response to a workflow_run of CI Pipeline.
Acceptance Criteria: Only workflow_run(CI Pipeline, completed) is declared; no other triggers exist.
Evidence to Collect: Workflow YAML snippet; Log of event payload

Requirement Statement: The workflow shall proceed only when workflow_run.conclusion == success.
Acceptance Criteria: Runs when conclusion=success; exits early otherwise.
Rationale: Gate downstream release on upstream success
Evidence to Collect: Logs showing guard evaluation; Run URLs with conclusions

Requirement Statement: The workflow shall proceed only when the upstream event is push.
Acceptance Criteria: Push events continue; non-push events skip.
Rationale: Restrict release flow to push provenance
Evidence to Collect: Guard log for push vs pull_request

Requirement Statement: The workflow shall evaluate head_branch against an allow-list (main, develop, release-alpha/*, release-beta/*, release-rc/*) with configurable extensions.
Acceptance Criteria: Allowed branches proceed; blocked branches emit diagnostic.
Evidence to Collect: Allow-list config snippet; Logs for allowed/disallowed branches

Requirement Statement: For branches outside the allow-list, the workflow shall terminate as a no-op and perform no tag or release.
Acceptance Criteria: No tags/releases created; log shows no-op decision.
Upstream Trace: SRS Section 9.1 no-op on disallowed branches
Evidence to Collect: Run log showing no-op; Tag/release list unchanged

Requirement Statement: The workflow shall ensure at most one run per commit SHA using a concurrency group keyed by the SHA.
Acceptance Criteria: Overlapping runs on same SHA cancel older run; only one completes.
Evidence to Collect: Concurrency block YAML; Run history showing cancel

Requirement Statement: When a new run starts for the same commit SHA, cancel any in-progress run (cancel-in-progress policy).
Acceptance Criteria: First run cancels; second run succeeds for same SHA.

Requirement Statement: The workflow shall log the configured concurrency policy (including group) at start for traceability.
Acceptance Criteria: Startup log contains concurrency_policy and concurrency_group once.
Risk: Lack of audit trail for dedupe

Requirement Statement: The workflow shall compute next version from last reachable tag, parsed semver, and commit count as BUILD.
Acceptance Criteria: Version = last tag semver bumped with build = commit count since tag.
Evidence to Collect: CI logs with last tag and commit count

Requirement Statement: When no previous tag exists, the base version shall default to 0.1.0 before bump rules.
Acceptance Criteria: Fallback version 0.1.0 is used when no tag is found.
